summary.zh-CN: Q、K、V 不是三份外部输入，而是同一组序列表示通过三组[[term:model-parameter|可学习]][[term:fully-connected-layer|线性层]]得到的三种角色表示。Q 用来发出查询，K 用来参与匹配，V 是匹配后真正被汇总的内容。
summary.en-US: Q, K, and V are not three external inputs. They are three role-specific representations produced from the same sequence representation by three learnable [[term:fully-connected-layer|linear layers]]. Q issues a query, K participates in matching, and V is the content actually aggregated after matching.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 同一个输入向量被三组参数投影成查询、索引和值，分别承担检索过程中的不同角色。
coreConclusion.en-US: One input vector is projected by three parameter sets into a query, an index, and a value, each with a different role in retrieval.
